description: No attendance count or reliable basis for 50 or more at an individual gathering is established. S005 describes small groups in Niamey on 25 February but provides no number; this does not settle the >=50 threshold.
required_followup: Read contemporary reports for each named action and record simultaneous gathered-person estimates; do not use arrests or other campaign totals as turnout.

description: S005 connects the Niamey action to the result dispute and reports the candidate alleging fraud, but no direct demand by a defined gathering. Search-only S076–S077 snippets point to campaign statements seeking suspension of results publication; bodies are unread and the gathering link is unestablished.
required_followup: Read contemporary statements and reports to identify the demand and whether it targeted Niger’s government/electoral process.

description: Reports identify Niamey and other towns and activity over multiple days. S005 specifies a Niamey street action on 25 February but does not resolve coordination, local-versus-national unit, or the full list of towns.
required_followup: Trace same-day locations, organizers, and demands; preserve local actions separately until evidence supports a national unit or linkage.

description: A 23 February start is reported by prior-unit consultations; S005 says the Niamey demonstrations continued on 25 February for a third consecutive day, consistent with that start. Physical ending of an action or broader episode remains unknown.
required_followup: Seek follow-up reports after February and distinguish last reported activity from physical closure.

description: S005 directly reports police tear gas at a Niamey street confrontation on 25 February and multiple arrests announced after prior-day demonstrations, but no arrest count or exact gathering assignment. Other state-response categories and locations remain unresolved.
required_followup: Keep tear gas and arrests tied to the specific reported Niamey episode/day; verify arrest scope and additional responses from contemporaneous reports before assigning them to other local gatherings.

description: S005 body was read after a fresh exact-URL gate: HTTPS GET HTTP 200 with no redirects. S056 and the earlier S005 web.open returned tool Cache miss without HTTP/body. Attempt016 and attempt018 stopped before request; attempt018 was a parser error caused by str.splitlines() splitting a valid U+2028 inside Haiti JSONL, corrected by LF-byte parsing. No denial was observed for S005, S056, or S073.
required_followup: In a newly opened coordinator request phase, give priority to the exact Agir Ensemble report URL in S073 for location/action detail, the African Union observer report S048 for observer-reported demands/places, and official ANP S070 for the prosecutor statement. Rebuild complete individual receipt/manual/hash/map gates for each; do not request bodies outside an open phase. Arrest or referral totals are not turnout.

description: Discovery used French and English, with limited local-language queries; Hausa/Zarma and local radio coverage are not systematic.
required_followup: Continue targeted local-language and local-radio searches where searchable; document gaps rather than infer absence.

description: Open-web discovery is not equivalent to LexisNexis; 18 captured search actions/batches and 485 ordered result headers are not an exhaustive census.
required_followup: Continue weekly/date/sector/region and local-language/local-radio discovery; document unavailable hemeroteca coverage and query results rather than infer protest=0.

description: Latest official Mass Mobilization version/universe/schema and the additional Coding Procedure remain unverified for this unit.
required_followup: Coordinator must resolve baseline and protocol gates before any official mapping or approval.
